title: Apiary Configuration Schema
description: JSON Schema for apiary.yaml workflow configuration files. Mirrors the Go structs in src/internal/config (config.go, workflow.go).

runners.description: Runner definitions for agent execution. The adapter is resolved as '{provider}-{type}' (or just 'type' when provider is empty); registered adapters: claude-cli, opencode-cli, codex-cli, cursor-cli, opencode-api

sandbox.description: Run this runner's agent subprocesses inside a Docker container isolated from the host filesystem. Contains filesystem/process access; does NOT contain network egress.

image.description: Docker image providing the agent binary

user.description: --user value; defaults to the daemon's uid:gid so the bind-mounted workspace stays writable

network.description: --network value; defaults to bridge because agents need LLM/git egress. Use "none" for agents needing no network

extra_args.description: Additional docker flags. Restricted to resource-limit and labelling flags (e.g. --memory, --cpus, --pids-limit, --ulimit, --label); anything that could weaken the sandbox is rejected

env_passthrough.description: Extra host environment variable names to forward to agents beyond the built-in allow-list (system vars + LLM provider credentials). Exact names or a trailing-* prefix, e.g. MYCORP_*

id.description: Unique runner identifier, referenced by agents[].runner and agents[].fallbacks

type.description: Execution engine: 'cli' (subprocess, combined with provider) or a self-contained adapter name like 'opencode-api'

provider.description: Which CLI the 'cli' engine drives. The adapter is resolved as '{provider}-{type}'; any unregistered combination fails at daemon startup with 'runner type not found'

config.description: Engine options. CLI engine keys: command, args, model_flag, prompt_flag, prompt_positional, turns_flag (provider presets cover them; override only when needed). API engine keys: api_key, base_url, endpoint

command.description: Binary to invoke (override to use a wrapper or absolute path). Preset: claude / opencode / codex / agent

args.description: Extra argv appended after the preset's args on every run. Presets: claude '--output-format stream-json --verbose', opencode 'run', codex 'exec --sandbox workspace-write', cursor '-p --output-format stream-json --force'

model_flag.description: Flag used to pass the step's model (preset: --model)

prompt_flag.description: Flag used to pass the prompt; empty with prompt_positional false delivers the prompt on stdin

prompt_positional.description: Pass the prompt as the last positional argument (preset: true for opencode, codex, and cursor)

turns_flag.description: Flag used to pass a max-turns limit

base_url.description: API runners: override the API base; /chat/completions is appended

endpoint.description: API runners: full URL override (takes precedence over base_url)

mcps.description: MCP servers exposed to every agent on this runner. Agent-scope mcps are layered on top, overriding by name

default_runner.description: Default runner ID used by agents that don't name a runner

id.description: Unique source identifier, referenced by trigger.match.source

config.description: Adapter-specific configuration. github: repo, api_key, base_url. plane: workspace, project, api_key, base_url

states.description: Only ingest items in these states

labels.description: Only ingest items carrying these labels

plugin_dirs.description: Directories searched for installed plugin folders. Relative paths resolve beside apiary.yaml; defaults to .apiary/plugins

plugins.description: Installed out-of-process plugin instances. Omitted enabled defaults to true; disabled plugins remain discoverable but are not started or schema-validated

timeout.description: Per-invocation deadline as a Go duration

config.description: Plugin-specific configuration validated against the manifest config_schema

model.description: Model name passed to the runner (e.g., 'claude-opus-4-8', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'gpt-5.5')

skills.description: Skill names injected into the agent's prompt

runner.description: Runner ID for this agent (uses default_runner if not specified)

max_workers.description: Maximum concurrent workers for this agent

worker_pool.description: Queue pool required for workflows using this agent

requires_labels.description: Worker labels required before a workflow can be claimed

requires_capabilities.description: Worker capabilities required before a workflow can be claimed

permissions.description: Per-agent tool permissions for runners that support them (OpenCode). An explicit entry always wins over the baseline set by settings.least_privilege_agents

workspace_affinity.description: Pin retries for this task to the worker that first claims it

max_turns.description: Maximum agent turns per step run. 0 (default) = unlimited: CLI runners omit the provider's turns flag

source_token.description: Per-agent source auth token; write operations (comments, labels, state changes) use this identity

source_email.description: Git author email exported to the runner environment

source_name.description: Git author name exported to the runner environment

env.description: Agent-scope environment variables for the agent subprocess. Lowest-precedence explicit scope (overridden by workflow.env and step.env), applied above the identity overlay (git + source_token)

fallbacks.description: Ordered rate-limit failover chain: alternative {runner, model} pairs tried when the primary runner is rejected by a provider rate limit

mcps.description: Agent-scope MCP servers, layered over the runner's mcps (same name overrides, new names are appended)

result_comment.description: Result comment mode (deprecated, use the APIARY_PUBLISH marker in agent output instead)

trigger.description: Selects which tasks start this workflow. Omit for named child workflows started via APIARY_SPAWN

exclusive.description: Stop trigger evaluation after this trigger matches: no lower-priority trigger is considered

once.description: Run this workflow at most once per task: once it has a completed instance for the task, later polls do not re-dispatch it. Failed runs stay eligible for retry up to settings.max_attempts

env.description: Workflow-scope environment variables applied to every step of this workflow. Overrides agent.env; overridden by step.env

state_lock.description: Move a task to an in-progress state while an agent works on it

result_comment.description: Post agent results as comments (deprecated, use the APIARY_PUBLISH marker in agent output instead)

refuse_root.description: Make running as root (euid 0) a startup error instead of a warning. Agent CLIs inherit the daemon's uid, so a prompt-injected agent would execute as root

least_privilege_agents.description: Deny edit/bash/webfetch by default for agents on runners that support per-agent permissions (OpenCode). Individual agents override via agents[].permissions

max_attempts.description: Stop re-dispatching a (task, workflow) pair after this many consecutive failed instances (rate-limited runs fail over and don't count). Default 3; negative disables

log_max_size_mb.description: Rotate apiary.log when it grows past this size in MB. Default 50; negative disables rotation

log_max_backups.description: Rotated log files to keep (apiary.log.1 .. .N, oldest dropped). Default 5; negative keeps none

log_max_age_days.description: Delete rotated backups, per-task log files, and SQLite log rows (service_logs/task_logs) older than this many days. Files are checked at startup and after each rotation; DB rows at startup and then daily. Default 30; negative disables

memory.description: Persistent agent memory: per-task working notes plus daemon-wide durable facts, written via the APIARY_MEMORIZE marker and stored as markdown files under the memory root. Disabled by default

path.description: Memory root directory. Empty means <data-dir>/memory — the .apiary/ folder beside the config file, next to apiary.db

max_inject_chars.description: Budget for the recall sections ([Long-term Memory] index + [Task Memory] notes) injected into each step prompt

max_entry_bytes.description: Cap on a single APIARY_MEMORIZE content

task_retention.description: How long task notes are kept after the task reaches a terminal state, as a Go duration. Global entries are never auto-pruned

cursor_cost.description: Back-fill cost_usd on finished cursor-cli executions from Cursor's dashboard usage API (cookie auth). The Cursor agent CLI streams token counts but no dollar cost, so when enabled the daemon periodically matches dashboard usage events to run time windows and records the billed amount. Best-effort: the endpoint is undocumented, and events overlapping concurrent cursor runs are left unattributed (recorded cost is a lower bound). Disabled by default

enabled.description: Enable the cursor-cli cost back-fill sweep

session_token.description: WorkosCursorSessionToken cookie value from a logged-in cursor.com browser session (valid ~60 days). Usually "${CURSOR_SESSION_TOKEN}" resolved from the .env file beside apiary.yaml; empty falls back to the CURSOR_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable

interval.description: Time between back-fill sweeps, as a Go duration (minimum 1m)

max_age.description: How far back unpriced executions are considered, as a Go duration

team_id.description: Cursor team id when the account bills through a team (the usual per-usage setup) — without it the API returns no events. 0 means a personal account. Find it in ~/.cursor/cli-config.json under authInfo.teamId

user_id.description: Filter team queries to this member's events so teammates' activity cannot pollute attribution. Strongly recommended whenever team_id is set (authInfo.userId in the same file)

git_hooks.description: Enforce a shared git hooks directory on the agents' repo checkouts. At startup the daemon sets core.hooksPath of every repo matched by 'repos' to 'dir' (and marks the scripts executable), so hooks like a pre-push running local lint/tests mechanically gate agent pushes — prompt rules alone are advisory. Both keys are required together

dir.description: Directory holding the hook scripts (pre-push, pre-commit, ...); absolute, ~-prefixed, or relative to the daemon working directory

repos.description: Glob patterns of git checkouts to enforce the hooks on (e.g. "../myproject--*"). Matches that are not git repos are skipped

queue.description: Durable dispatch queue and distributed worker protocol. Enabled with an embedded local worker by default

listen.description: TCP address for the authenticated worker protocol, for example 0.0.0.0:8080

worker_token.description: Bearer token required by remote workers; use an environment reference such as ${APIARY_WORKER_TOKEN}

tasks.description: Top-level task completion hooks. Fire once per InternalTask when the LAST of its fanned-out workflows reaches a terminal state: on_complete when all succeeded, on_fail when any failed

notifications.description: Escalation notifications: whenever a hook (workflow on_fail/on_complete, task-level hooks, or the failure-cap park) adds one of on_labels to a source item, every channel fires — so a flow parked with needs-attention pings a human instead of freezing silently

channels.description: Notification hooks fired in order for each matched label

type.description: Channel kind; only "command" is supported (an arbitrary shell hook: ntfy, Slack webhook via curl, osascript, ...)

run.description: Shell command to run. {{task_id}}, {{cell_id}}, {{number}}, {{title}}, {{url}}, {{label}}, {{summary}} placeholders are substituted shell-quoted; the same values are exported as APIARY_* environment variables

QueueLimits.description: Positive concurrency limits keyed by scope id

MCPServer.description: A Model Context Protocol server launched over stdio and exposed to the CLI tool

env.description: Environment overlay for the server subprocess; ${VAR} references are expanded at config load

FallbackConfig.description: One entry in an agent's rate-limit failover chain

runner.description: Runner ID to fail over to (must be defined in runners)

model.description: Model to use on that runner (empty uses the runner's default)

labels.description: Match tasks with any of these labels

title_regex.description: Match task titles against this regex

exclude_labels.description: Reject tasks carrying any of these labels (case-insensitive)

exclude_label_prefix.description: Reject tasks with any label starting with this prefix (case-insensitive), e.g. 'agent:'

OnComplete.description: Source-side actions applied on workflow/task completion or failure

set_state.description: Set task state to this value

add_labels.description: Add these labels to the task

remove_labels.description: Remove these labels from the task, e.g. to clear a label-driven trigger so the item is not matched again. Applied after add_labels

StepConfig.description: A workflow step. Type selects the active fields: agent (default), split, approval, foreach, workflow, or wait_for. v2 authoring fields (if, reject_when, on_reject, steps, parallel, join, for_each, max, output) are lowered to the DAG IR before execution

id.description: Unique step identifier within the workflow

name.description: Human-readable step name for logs and dashboards

condition.description: DAG IR condition expression (e.g., 'memory.track == "implement"'). Skip step if false. Prefer the v2 'if:' field when authoring

fail_when.description: DAG IR expression evaluated after the agent runs; true → logical rejection. Prefer the v2 'reject_when:' field when authoring

seq_depends_on.description: Step IDs that must complete before this step (explicit sequencing)

model.description: Override the agent's model for this step (for type=agent)

prompt.description: Task prompt for the agent (for type=agent)

summary_prompt.description: Prompt asking the agent for a short summary recorded on the step (for type=agent)

idempotent.description: Mark step as idempotent for resume safety (for type=agent)

on_missing_output.description: Behavior when output_schema is declared but not satisfied

publish.description: Whether an APIARY_PUBLISH payload emitted by this step's agent is written back to the task's source bindings (for type=agent)

spawn.description: How an APIARY_SPAWN request emitted by this step's agent is handled: auto (fire-and-forget) or await (block until the spawned task is terminal; child failure fails the step)

env.description: Step-scope environment variables. Highest-precedence explicit scope: overrides workflow.env and agent.env for the same key

on_conflict.description: Merge-conflict edge of a wait_for/ci step (goto + max_retries). When the step fails because the PR has merge conflicts, this route governs the loop-back exclusively, with its own retry budget separate from on_fail. Only valid on a wait_for step

wait_for.description: Configuration for a wait_for step (required for type=wait_for)

items.description: DAG IR expression yielding the items array (for type=foreach). Prefer the v2 'for_each:' field when authoring

max_items.description: Maximum items to iterate (for type=foreach). Prefer the v2 'max:' field when authoring

fail_fast.description: Stop on first iteration failure (for type=foreach)

if.description: v2 guard expression (e.g., "${{ memory.complexity == 'high' }}"). When false the step is skipped. Lowers to condition

reject_when.description: v2 rejection gate expression evaluated against memory plus this step's fresh structured output. Lowers to fail_when

steps.description: v2 sequential group of child steps, inlined into the parent during lowering

join.description: Parallel join policy: all (default), any, or a '${{ expr }}' expression

for_each.description: v2 fan-out expression (e.g., '${{ design.tasks }}'). Lowers to items + foreach

max.description: v2 loop cap. Lowers to max_items

WaitForConfig.description: Configures a wait_for step that suspends the workflow until an external condition resolves, re-checking each poll cycle until it is met or times out

kind.description: What to poll: 'ci' (CI status of the PR linked to the task) or 'dependency' (the task's upstream blockers, e.g. Jira 'is blocked by' links — the step parks until every blocker is merged/Done, then auto-resumes)

check_interval.description: How often to query the status (e.g., '30s'). Defaults to 1m

max_duration.description: Total timeout for polling (e.g., '2h'). Defaults to 2h for kind 'ci' and to no deadline for kind 'dependency'

fail_if_not_passed.description: Reject the step if CI is not green (kind 'ci' only)

remove_label.description: Remove this label from the task before polling begins (resets stale labels from previous runs)

satisfied_when.description: Kind 'dependency' only: conditions under which a blocker counts as satisfied — 'merged' (a linked PR merged) and/or 'done' (status is Done-category). A blocker is satisfied when ANY listed condition holds. Defaults to [merged, done]

blocker_link_type.description: Kind 'dependency' only: the source-native relation that marks a blocker (e.g. Jira's 'Blocks' link type, read from its inward 'is blocked by' side). Empty uses the source's default blocking relation

on_timeout.description: What happens when max_duration elapses: 'fail' fails the step, 'hold' keeps the instance parked for a human. Defaults to fail for kind 'ci' and hold for kind 'dependency'

OutputSchema.description: Supported JSON Schema subset for structured step output (type must be 'object')

SchemaField.description: One property within an OutputSchema. items for arrays; properties/required for nested objects

MemoryConfig.description: How a step interacts with the workflow memory object and the persistent memory store (settings.memory)

read.description: Inject the workflow memory document into this step (default true; only an explicit false disables it). Gates the persistent recall sections too

write.description: output_schema field names this step persists to workflow memory

recall.description: Persistent memory tiers injected into this step's prompt. Empty/omitted means both. Only meaningful when settings.memory.enabled is true

memorize.description: How APIARY_MEMORIZE requests emitted by this step's agent are handled: auto (default, persist) or off (drop)

StepNext.description: Explicit success edge of an agent step

next.description: Step ID to jump to on success

StepOutcome.description: Failure edge of a step (loop-back with a retry budget)

goto.description: Step ID to jump to (e.g., a retry loop) on failure

max_retries.description: Maximum loop-back cycles through this edge

SplitBranch.description: One conditional edge of a split step. A branch is the fallback when else is true or if is empty

if.description: DAG IR condition to take this branch (e.g., 'memory.agent == "po"')

else.description: Mark this branch as the catch-all/else branch

goto.description: Step ID to jump to when this branch is taken

ApprovalTrigger.description: Resume/abort condition for an approval step. Any single populated field that matches the live task is sufficient (OR semantics)

comment_contains.description: Trigger when a new comment contains this substring

label_added.description: Trigger when this label is added to the task

state_changed.description: Trigger when the task enters this state

OnRejectConfig.description: v2 loop-back spec for reject_when gates. Lowers to on_fail (goto + max_retries)

restart_from.description: Earlier sibling step to restart from when rejected
